name: Hover League
hook: Neon hovercraft, banked turns, three laps.
how: Your craft thrusts on its own: steer through the banked turns and fly over the arrow pads for a boost. Air-brake to swing round tight corners. First over the line after three laps wins.
controls: Arrow keys or A/D to steer, Shift or Down to air-brake, or on-screen buttons
uses: The fastest laps on the track.
The host's browser starts, ends and restarts each race; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the grid until enough people join.
Every craft flies for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a loop-the-loop to the track
Add a shield pickup that blocks one bump
Make it a desert canyon at sunset
